text:
maria: Heads up — ran into a nasty replay/duplicate-create when our py SDK client times out and retries a POST without an idempotency key.  Repro steps below.
kevin: ugh, that sounds bad. can you paste the minimal repro?
maria: sure, small snippet:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.create_document({'title': 'new doc'})  # POST /v1/docs
# we set timeout=1s on the session, the server occasionally returns 504 and client retries
```
laura: is this using the sync client or async? previous issues showed different behavior for async replay.
maria: sync. default retry policy in 0.8.2 does a simple retry on socket.timeout and 5xx, but it replays the entire body. no idempotency header added.
sam: do you have logs? curious if it's the transport or higher-level retry.
maria: pasted log snippet: "POST /v1/docs 504 (timeout), retrying request (no idempotency key) -> 201 Created" — duplicated resource id in downstream service.
kevin: we should probably default to add an Idempotency-Key header when body is application/json and method is POST, unless caller explicitly provides none? would help catch a lot of cases.
laura: +1 but that changes semantics. some customers rely on non-idempotent behavior. maybe opt-in via client config, or a per-request flag.
sam: also need to surface this in typing and docs: AsyncClient has replay behavior different from sync (it reuses the body stream incorrectly). I can open an issue to align them.
maria: created a small fork reproducer here: https://git.internal/repros/py-replay (private link)
kevin: short-term mitigation: bump default timeout and reduce retry count for POSTs. Also add a warning in SDK when POST + retries enabled + no Idempotency-Key.
laura: agree. For long-term: add an idempotency middleware that can generate RFC4122-like UUIDs, but only if client config idempotency_on_retry=true. document it in RELEASE_NOTES.
sam: note: need to check how this interacts with streaming/generator bodies for multipart uploads — can't auto-buffer huge payloads. maybe only auto-idempotency for < 1MB bodies.
maria: test matrix I'd run: sync vs async, small JSON vs file-stream, 5xx vs timeout, explicit id key present vs not.
kevin: can someone pick up a bug for async body replay? laura?
laura: I can take async fix. will PR to ensure transport buffers body for small payloads and errors out if non-bufferable and retries requested.
kevin: thx. sam, can you draft a short docs blurb for onboarding that warns about POST retries and shows how to set idempotency keys?
sam: on it. will include code examples and mention the limit for auto-generated keys.
maria: filing a support note for the customer who hit this. CC @devex-bot to create incident ticket. :pray:
devex-bot: Created ticket #DE-4721 for duplicate-create during POST retries, assigned to laura and sam.
kevin: prioritize as P2 — revert in case of regression in async? also add unit tests around ReplayableBody and Idempotency header behavior.
laura: noted. I'll add tests for both sync and async clients.
maria: thanks all — appreciate the quick triage. I'll update thread if we see more repros.
